title: Shinmai Maou no Testament: BURST Specials
justification: AniList: 5 shorts of 4 min, 2015-12-25 to 2016-04-27. AniDB 11142 S1-S5 "Special 1-5" on 2015-12-25, 2016-01-29, 02-26, 03-25, 04-27. TVDB 284719 season 0 0x9-0x13 "BURST Special 1-5" on the same dates, the parent's row offset 8 places them there. The numbered titles and five dates agree in order; 0x1-0x8 are the first season's and 11000/11890, 0x14-0x15 are 13543's.
